kicker: Week of Sep 30 · episode No. 16 · read Oct 5
headline: Ten new followers, most since August. Fewer posts reached fewer people.

verdicts.label: Reach
verdicts.text: 5.9 a post, but only 47 all week

moves.title: Tag the venue in every picture
moves.why: Three weeks of a half-and-half test: tagged posts read 9.0, untagged 6.6, ahead every week. New people reached each week tracked how many posts were tagged.
moves.plan: Every venue post from Wed Oct 7 carries the venue tagged in the image. Say don't and it goes back to half.

moves.title: Venue stories back to single posts
moves.why: The Ijams carousel read 4 for three stories; as singles they'd read about 13. Weekly reach follows the number of posts, and two-a-day already stops the stacking.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 7 every story gets its own post again; the weekend roundup stays on top. Say don't and a venue's extra stories fold into one carousel.

moves.title: A weekly Reel from the audio briefing
moves.why: Only 1 of the 19 people reached this week is a non-follower. Reels are how Instagram reaches people who don't follow you; all 114 posts are stills.
moves.plan: The sample is above. The first Reel goes out with No. 18 on Wed Oct 14 unless you say don't; the publish path gets built Mon Oct 12.

done.title: The venue notes went out.
done.text: Five first notes sent: Legacy Parks, Earl's, Ijams, Kern's, Puckers. Open 48 days, now closed. Weekly notes send themselves from here.

done.title: The roundup posted as a carousel.
done.text: Both carousels went out properly, no fallback. The weekend one stays: it read the same as the card it replaced.

done.title: The image-tag test is decided.
done.text: Three weeks, tagged ahead every week. From Wednesday every venue post is tagged in the picture.

done.title: Last week kept growing.
done.text: No. 15 rose from 69 to 93 reach as it aged, No. 14 from 84 to 116. Posts earn reach for two weeks.
